organization.name_ja: 株式会社はるやまホールディングス

affected.note: Customers, business partners and employees of the group. The investigation found no trace of data exfiltration, but the company said it could not rule out that the data was viewed. Credit card data is not included.

summary.en: Haruyama Holdings detected unauthorized access to its group servers on 2025-06-26, and business data and software on multiple servers were encrypted by ransomware. Its final report said 18,053 records of customers, partners and employees may have leaked, although no exfiltration was found.
summary.ja: はるやまホールディングスは2025年6月26日にグループのサーバーへの不正アクセスを検知し、複数のサーバーで業務データ等がランサムウェアにより暗号化された。最終報で、外部流出の痕跡はないものの、顧客、取引先、従業員の個人情報18,053件が漏えいした可能性があると公表した。
